state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the annual training budget for a regular employee who holds a team-lead role today? (answer in EUR per year)
- Q2: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.

Integration smoke run (this instance only): start with one search with k=6 for the first question. If the result lists omitted passages, print one of them with show(). Then answer normally.

passages.source: HB-06 §3 | Learning policy: training budget — Additions | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-07-01 to the day before 2026-03-01 · superseded by: HB-07
passages.text: For employees who hold a team-lead role, 500 EUR per year was added to the standard annual training budget. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation.

passages.source: HB-07 §3 | Learning policy: training budget — Additions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-03-01 · supersedes: HB-06
passages.text: For employees who hold a team-lead role, 500 EUR per year is added to the standard annual training budget. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred.

passages.source: HB-07 §2 | Learning policy: training budget — Standard annual training budget | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-03-01 · supersedes: HB-06
passages.text: Each employee has an annual training budget of 900 EUR per calendar year. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header.

passages.source: HB-09 §2 | Memo: annual training budget exceptions — Exception for employees in the security team | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-07-01
passages.text: For employees in the security team, the annual training budget is 2100 EUR per year instead of the standard amount. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section.

passages.source: HB-04 §1 | Policy FAQ — Current annual training budget | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard annual training budget? A: 900 EUR per year, as set in HB-07 §2 (effective 2026-03-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-09.

passages.source: HB-06 §2 | Learning policy: training budget — Standard annual training budget | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-07-01 to the day before 2026-03-01 · superseded by: HB-07
passages.text: Each employee has an annual training budget of 1350 EUR per calendar year. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location.
